segments.title: Trump China Trip & Spencer Pratt Mayoral Run
segments.notes: Case Blackwell covers Trump's diplomatic visit to China and the Los Angeles mayoral race featuring reality TV personality Spencer Pratt.

segments.title: Hospital Type Beat Derailment
segments.notes: Card King's 300-bit donation triggers Hype Train, who abandons sub acknowledgments for a surreal freestyle session over hospital-themed beats.

segments.title: MrBeast vs Burnt Peanut Sacrifice Debate
segments.notes: Crum and Munch debate which content creator should be 'sacrificed'; poll phrasing confusion leads to contested victory and mutual accusations of theft.

segments.title: Complaint Integration: Nipples, Knees & Vinegar Pie
segments.notes: AI Rooney processes viewer grievances ranging from debate bucket angles to knee-skin puppets, Reese's Pieces superiority, and politicians' leaking nipple culture.

segments.title: Vinegar Pie at the Michigan Magazine Museum Kitchen
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget presents a 1970s cooking show segment on vinegar pie while troubleshooting mono audio; ends with Latoya Jackson step workout raid to Dr. Diggity Dank.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored China trip coverage, recounted MrBeast interview history, and analyzed Spencer Pratt's LA mayoral campaign.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold-open station sign-on as 'Papito the dog that produces the show'.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: host of Amongst the Web. Appeared early with vocal issues; provided geopolitical analysis on US-China trade dynamics.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued for MrBeast in sacrifice debate; claimed victory after poll phrasing confusion; briefly displayed yellow visual glitch.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued for Burnt Peanut; accused Crum of stealing victory; defended mods amid polling chaos.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Derailed sub acknowledgments into extended hospital-beat freestyle about colostomy bags, IV methadone, and mental hospitals.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Presented vinegar pie recipe from archival Michigan cooking show while battling left-channel audio failure.

lore_notes.fact: Interviewed for MrBeast's company after G4 shutdown; declined offer requiring relocation to South Carolina and development of 'Jimmy Brain'.
Also interviewed with MrBeast's organization alongside Case.
Running for LA mayor with AI-generated attack ads; polling at ~22% behind Karen Bass (30%) and Nithya Raman.
Suffering mono audio reception (left channel only) during How To segment.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered President Trump's diplomatic visit to China alongside a deep dive into Spencer Pratt's surprise mayoral campaign in Los Angeles. The broadcast devolved into a chaotic Hype Train derailment, a contested Munch & Crum debate over sacrificing MrBeast versus Burnt Peanut, and an AI Rooney session fixated on knee-skin puppets and politician nipple culture. Jeb Nogget closed the show with a vinegar pie tutorial from a 1970s Michigan cooking show while troubleshooting a mono audio failure.
